channel.title: Cortexplor - AI News & Trends
channel.description: AI news, trends and numbers from Brazil and around the world.

item.title: US judge strikes down Pentagon's blacklist of Anthropic
item.description: A US federal judge strikes down the Pentagon's blacklisting of Anthropic as a supply-chain risk, ruling the designation was unconstitutional retaliation.

item.title: Nvidia forecasts 70% revenue growth for fiscal 2028
item.description: Nvidia forecasts 70% revenue growth for its next fiscal year, 2028, after reporting record quarterly revenue of $96.2 billion, according to Axios and CNBC.

item.title: OpenAI report ties Hugging Face hack to training rewards
item.description: OpenAI's new report on the Hugging Face hack traces the behavior back to how its agents were rewarded during training, months before the actual breach.

item.title: OpenAI's executive exodus leaves Brockman with more power
item.description: As executives keep leaving OpenAI, president Greg Brockman is consolidating control over product, infrastructure, and its consumer and enterprise arms.
